thread:
maya: FYI we just got INV-2026-219 from PortoData Consulting Lda (PT). Amount 18,500 EUR. They marked 'Foreign (non-US)' but didn't attach any W-8. They have VAT PT123456789 and charged 23% VAT on the invoice. Quick ask: do we need a W-8BEN-E for a Portuguese company? Do we need to withhold US tax or gross-up? Also should we ask them to re-issue without VAT (we're a US buyer)? @sam @owen

marta: :robot_face: Invoice bot: INV-2026-219, total 18,500 EUR, invoice date 2026-05-08, bank details present, no tax documentation attached.

owen: Short answer: ask them for a W-8BEN-E (company cert). Withholding only kicks in if the payment is US-source or services were performed in the US. Can you confirm where the work was done? For VAT, as a US buyer we generally aren't liable; EU vendors often zero-rate exports to non-EU B2B. Ask for reissue without VAT or a VAT 0% line. I'll handle vendor outreach. :+1:

sam: Legal here. If PortoData is an Lda (Portuguese company), W-8BEN-E is the correct US IRS form (not W-8BEN). No gross-up unless contract explicitly says so. If services were actually performed in the US, we may need to consider withholding — but that requires facts (location of service, nexus). Ask them to confirm service location and provide the completed W-8BEN-E.

priya: AP has put the invoice on hold in NetSuite. HOLD note: "Awaiting W-8BEN-E and VAT clarification from PortoData." Payment will not be scheduled until vendor either reissues without VAT or provides valid VAT/legal justification + tax docs. I'll chase vendor; escalation to tax team if no clear justification after 72h.

owen: Drafted email to vendor and posted to portal (sent 2026-05-10 15:12 UTC):
---
Hi PortoData team,

Thanks for INV-2026-219. Before we can process payment please:
1) Confirm the country where the services were performed (Portugal vs US vs other).
2) If services were performed outside the US, reissue invoice without VAT or indicate "VAT 0% - export of services / B2B". We are a US company and typically not subject to EU VAT for cross-border B2B services.
3) Provide a completed, signed W-8BEN-E for PortoData Consulting Lda.

If you believe VAT should be charged, please provide the legal basis. Otherwise please reissue.

Thanks,
Owen (Vendor Ops)
---

own: Sent and CC'd AP.

maya: Quick clarifying Q — do we ever accept EU VAT and then reclaim? We don't have an EU VAT registration so we can't reclaim, correct?

sam: Correct, we don't reclaim EU VAT without an EU registration. So we should ask vendor to remove VAT. If they insist, request their basis for charging and escalate. No Redwood gross-up unless contract requires.

priya: Will update the AP ticket with vendor portal messages and escalate to tax/legal if we get conflicting guidance. Flags: 72h vendor SLA for response.

maya: Great, thanks. Action items: Owen follow up 48h for reissue + W-8BEN-E; Priya keep on hold and escalate after 72h; Sam available if vendor pushes back on VAT or withholding. :white_check_mark:
